metadata.title: Rustic Monochromatic Portrait with Custom Script

retrievalProfile.description: A two-tone rustic portrait featuring a bearded figure in a cowboy hat framed by a circle and anchored by interlocking custom script.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are requested
clean vector lines without texture are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, two-tone illustration centered on a bearded man wearing a cowboy hat. The portrait uses organic stippling and hatching for shading, enclosed within a thin circular border. The bottom of the composition is anchored by a custom, hand-lettered script with exaggerated swashes and interlocking characters that break the circular frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject breaks the circular frame at the shoulders and hat brim
Typography overlaps the lower portion of the portrait and frame
Consistent stippled texture across both illustration and text
High-contrast relationship between deep burgundy and pale cream

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered bust-up portrait, filling approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The interlocking script at the bottom center acts as the heavy visual base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, follow the beard down to the script, then circle back via the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid, flat background color surrounding the central circular emblem.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast, low saturation, two-tone value system.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Serif-based script with Victorian and Western influences
letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated swashes on initial and terminal characters
Varying stroke weight with thick verticals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'S' features a long, looping tail that underlines the word
Letters 'T' and 'P' interlock through their stems
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom typeface style to maintain hand-crafted aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ornate, swashed aesthetic of the era
Captures the interlocking and organic flow

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic stippled portrait of a man with a long beard and cowboy hat inside a thin circular frame on a dark burgundy background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered script at the bottom, ensuring the letters interlock and have a distressed, grainy texture matching the illustration.

verificationChecks: Does the text overlap the circular frame?
Is the stipple texture consistent across image and text?
Are the swashes on the letters exaggerated and flowing?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between image and text

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent grain across the entire canvas
Ensure no third color is introduced
Verify that the text is legible despite the swashes
Confirm the portrait breaks the circle at the shoulders
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Stipple Portrait + Circular Frame + Interlocking Custom Script Anchor
